title: Acoustic re-identification research
description: Research software for recording-context diagnostics in acoustic animal re-identification. Version 0.2.0 corrects tied-score verification, excludes invalid magnitude controls from cosine-only analyses, and supports local result archiving. The accompanying v8 author manuscript is a corrected draft awaiting archived-result verification and author declarations. The complete numerical evidence bundle is not included. Apache-2.0 applies to the original software; author publications and third-party resources retain their separate terms.
